inputs.name: checkov_version
inputs.description: checkov release to install from PyPI. Its packages are pinned in requirements/checkov-<version>.txt, or in requirements_file.

inputs.name: requirements_file
inputs.description: Path, on the machine running Conn3x, of a pip requirements file that pins checkov_version and every package it needs, each with --hash. When null, the one this circuit ships for checkov_version.
